description: 311 Toronto publishes the customer-initiated service requests it receives by telephone, fax, email, online self-serve, mobile API and Twitter on behalf of the divisions that take part: Solid Waste Management, Transportation Services, Toronto Water, Municipal Licensing and Standards, and Urban Forestry. Attributes include the creation date and time of each request, its location recorded as the first three characters of the postal code (the forward sortation area) and intersection or ward information, and the request type and division. Coverage: the City of Toronto, with one file per year from 2015 to 2026. Access: free ZIP files on the portal and through its CKAN API, refreshed monthly (last refresh 8 September 2026). Licence: Open Government Licence - Toronto. Caveats: locations are coarsened to postal areas, not points, and only participating divisions are included. Simulation uses: demand for street, tree and water repairs after storms, and seasonal maintenance planning for the public realm. Related records: NYC 311 service requests, Dallas 311 service requests and the Open311 standard.
